name: Blocky
summary: Shopify fraud filter that blocks visitors and orders by country, IP (v4 and v6), email, name, address and phone, with an AI bot blocker for TOR, proxy and VPN traffic that gets past reCAPTCHA, country redirects, a right-click blocker and visitor analytics. Not sold to Shopify Plus stores.
best_for: Shopify stores below Plus that are losing time to bot traffic, repeat fraudsters or orders from regions they do not ship to, and want blocking rules they control rather than a full security suite
skip_if: you are on Shopify Plus, where Basic and Pro exclude you and only the $39.99 Plus plan is sold, or you need chargebacks disputed and revenue recovered rather than visitors kept out
honest_knock:
Read the plan text before you pick a tier. The listing now has a real Free plan, but it stops at 4 country and IP rules, so treat it as a trial of the idea rather than a working fraud filter. Basic and Pro carry the line 'all stores except for Shopify Plus stores'; a Plus store is sold the separate Plus plan at $39.99 a month, so check with the developer which plan covers you before you plan around it.

A blocker is a blunt instrument, and the review distribution shows it: 365 reviews read on 13 November 2026, 89% of them at the top rating and 5% at the bottom: twenty one-star reviews, up from eighteen on 5 October. Rules that stop fraud also stop customers. A blocked country catches the expat who wanted to buy; a VPN rule catches the privacy-minded shopper. The tuning is yours to do, continuously, using the unlimited visitor analytics logs that only the Pro tier includes (the Free plan covers the first 300 visits).

And it prevents rather than recovers. Nothing here disputes a chargeback that has already landed or claws back an order that already shipped. For that you need a separate dispute tool, which is a second subscription on top of this one.

pricing.entry_price_terms: Basic Plan · per month (or $67.11 a year) for unlimited country and IP blocking plus the Bot Killer
pricing.notes: (re-verified 2026-11-13 on apps.shopify.com/blocky-simple-country-blocker, where the app is now listed as Bloky Fraud Filter Bot Blocker) Four plans. The ladder was rebuilt after our 2 November reading: the Development Stores plan and the Advanced tier are gone, and a Free plan and a Plus plan have appeared. The Free plan allows up to 4 country and IP rules, blocking directly in checkout, visitor analytics for the first 300 visits, the default blocked page and online support; its plan card carries no development-store restriction. Basic is $7.99 a month or $67.11 a year (a stated 30% saving; it was $9.99 and $59.94): unlimited country blocking, unlimited IP and IP-range blocking, an IP whitelist, the Bot Killer for VPN, proxy and Tor traffic, blocking directly in checkout, a fully customisable blocked page and a custom checkout blocked message. Pro is $16.99 a month or $101.94 a year (a stated 50% saving; it was $19.99 and $119.94) and adds geolocation redirects by country, blocking by email and phone, blocking by name and address, an add-ons checkout blocker, right-click and content protection and unlimited visitor analytics traffic logs. Plus is $39.99 a month or $239.94 a year, for Shopify Plus stores only, and adds automatic cancellation of fraud orders to everything in Pro. Basic and Pro state in their own plan text: all stores except for Shopify Plus stores. The plan cards no longer list a 7-day free trial; the developer's reply to a review dated 20 August 2026 still mentions one. All charges are billed in USD and recur every 30 days. Developer Effective Apps, 13 Max Nordau, Ashdod, 7722119, Israel; the app launched 7 April 2021 and still carries Shopify's “Built for Shopify” badge. The review record keeps moving: 365 reviews averaging 4.7 on 13 November 2026, up from 324 on 22 August, 346 on 18 September, 355 on 5 October and 362 on 2 November, distributed 325 five-star, 16 four-star, 3 three-star, 1 two-star and 20 one-star. The developer replies to reviews on the listing, including an August 2026 reply explaining what the Basic plan is meant to cover.
